about_the_game:
Prologue

The short but pleasant seven-day summer vacation has come to an end

The senior grade experimental class of Lanzhu Middle School welcomed a new student who transferred from Chang'an City, the provincial capital

Her outstanding academic performance was like a "dimensional reduction attack", causing a profound shock to the already highly accomplished students in the class

Her outstanding appearance made even those who were previously quite confident about their own looks feel as if their once-secure sense of self-worth had suddenly vanished like the faint glow of decaying leaves in the face of the bright moon in the sky

Her behavior and speech were very proper, but she always gave off a sense of aloofness and detachment.

Regarding the reason for transferring schools, she has always remained silent and seems to have some undisclosed secrets

Not participating in the morning exercises and not attending the evening classes, she was isolated from the entire class like an outsider. This made the classmates in the class feel dissatisfied

However, whenever an exam approaches, no one can ignore her overly impressive academic record......

Characters intro

A student who transferred from a key middle school in Chang 'an, the provincial capital, has excellent academic performance and no weak points in any subject!

She is strikingly beautiful and well-mannered, but seems reluctant to open up to others and has always kept a subtle distance from her classmates. She is truly a beauty on a high ridge

She is the envy and aspiration of her classmates in the class, but the reason for her transfer has always been a mystery, and she herself is very reluctant to bring it up

Since she transferred to Class 1, Senior 3 Science at Lanzhu Middle School, as there were no extra seats in the front row, she has always been deskmates with He Wei, who was sitting in the last row of the classroom

One of the top four students in Class One of Science in Senior Three, she has excellent grades in all subjects except physics

She has a very delicate and sensitive personality, and is somewhat of a people-pleasing type. She is not good at saying no to others and often falls into anxiety because her physics grades improve too slowly

She enjoy drawing and watching animations, but after entering her senior year of high school, she decided to temporarily stop drawing and focus my energy on my studies

She and He Wei grew up on the same street as childhood sweethearts

Setting of the story

Lanzhu 

A small town located deep in the mountains in the south of Yongxi Province

Yongxi Province, which has a huge north-south span, is naturally divided into three different geographical units by mountains

The northern plateau is vast with loess, crisscrossed with gullies and rich in mineral resources

The central plain has been prosperous since ancient times and has given birth to a thousand-year-old capital

The mountainous areas in the south are beautiful and crisscrossed with rivers

Lanzhu Middle School

The only ordinary high school in Lanzhu

short_description: A Transfer Student from Chang'an is a Chinese-style school-themed visual novel. A student with excellent grades who transferred from a provincial key middle school suddenly becomes your deskmate. What is the reason she always avoids discussing about her transfer reason? Let's go and seek the answer
